usis10k|Original_Restormer384_ConceptBan.annotation_note: No safely mapped source GT. Temperature and KD weight inherited from same-path pooled external TRAIN GT. The reported mIoU is NOT this source accuracy. Images receive KL only.

calibration_unit: One common positive T across5classes per source and complete inference route. Original/Restormer384/ConceptBank/E034 individual branch fits are also reported as diagnostics; they do not change branch selection.
rationale: The actual teacher uses selective fusion, not four independent teachers. Final fused targets are calibrated in their own distribution, preserving native argmax.
limitations: TRAIN diagnostics, not out-of-sample teacher quality.
External GT is partial and class composition differs; source mIoU ratios are the requested heuristic, not calibrated reliability probabilities.
E034 pretraining included ray1/seahorse1. Local student gains may reflect inherited teacher exposure; use local only as -1.5pp retention check.
